author: benjaminbooth
message:
fix(llm): an OpenAI stream ends with whole usage or none, and the bridge's prefix session id survives a moved cache marker (#2373)

Two faults found reviewing 0.70.46.

#2229 made every OpenAI-format stream end with a usage object that held
only prompt_tokens_details. A client that reads usage.prompt_tokens when
usage is present found nothing there. The last chunk now carries
prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens and the cached count when
the provider reported usage, and no usage at all when it did not, as
before #2229.

#2250 hashes the system prompt, the tools and the first message into a
conversation id when a harness states none. Since #2229 the first message
keeps its cache marker, which a harness moves to the newest message each
turn, so the id changed after turn 1. Cache markers are left out of the
hashed prefix.

The docstring now says what the prefix cannot do: the bridge has no caller
identity, so two conversations with the same opening share an id unless
the harness sends a session header.
